user_story: As a user, I can load the hosted dashboard without uncaught JavaScript errors.
expected_behavior: A fresh load emits no parse, redeclaration, or runtime errors.
baseline_result: Four uncaught errors including Invalid or unexpected token and repeated blogPrefetching declarations.
regression_result: Production desktop and mobile cache-busted loads emitted zero page errors.

user_story: As a user, I get deterministic controls backed by unique DOM IDs.
expected_behavior: The generated document contains no duplicate IDs or repeated modal/script blocks.
baseline_result: 42 duplicate IDs were present in the deployed document.
regression_result: Production desktop and mobile checks found zero duplicate IDs.

user_story: As a public explorer user, I do not see retired sign-in or billing actions.
expected_behavior: Log In, Upgrade navigation, and Upgrade content are absent from the read-only Sites build.
baseline_result: Log In and Upgrade were exposed; Upgrade activated an invisible section.
regression_result: The rendered production dashboard and Agent contain no AI Dashboard has moved notice.

user_story: As a user, I can browse, search, sort, and refresh text-to-image rankings.

baseline_result: Deployed navigation/data smoke passed in isolated Chromium.
regression_result: Production post-fix smoke passed at desktop and mobile viewports.

user_story: As a user, I can learn about Adam and open project, profile, and support links.
expected_behavior: Content renders and external links open safely in new tabs.
baseline_result: Deployed navigation/data smoke passed in isolated Chromium.
regression_result: Production post-fix smoke passed at desktop and mobile viewports.

user_story: As a user, I can ask dashboard-data questions and use suggestions.
expected_behavior: Text submits, answers and tool status stream, and new chat resets conversation.
baseline_result: Deployed navigation/data smoke passed in isolated Chromium.
regression_result: A real Top LLMs prompt called /api/llms with HTTP 200 and rendered current named models plus tool/result/chart content from live dashboard data.

user_story: As a user, I can generate or regenerate AI model analysis.

user_story: As a signed-in user, my authenticated state persists for the configured session lifetime.
expected_behavior: A reload within the session keeps the account state and remote user data available.
baseline_result: Permanent Flask session remained authenticated across page reload and subsequent /api/me request.
regression_result: Permanent Flask session remained authenticated across page reload and subsequent /api/me request.
